attachmentName.description: The full filename of the attachment (mapped from EFileAttachInfo.Filename)

fileName.description: The short filename without path (mapped from EFileAttachInfo.ShortFileName)

description.description: Human-readable description of the attachment (mapped from EFileAttachInfo.Title)

jurisdictionAttachmentCode.description: Jurisdiction code - "FE" for Federal, or state number for state attachments (mapped from EFileAttachInfo.AttachCode)

size.description: File size as string representation (mapped from EFileAttachInfo.FileSize.ToString())

lastModified.description: Last modification date as string (mapped from EFileAttachInfo.DateMod)

addionalInfo1.description: First additional information field, null if not available (mapped from EFileAttachInfo.ArrayInput[0])

addionalInfo2.description: Second additional information field, null if not available (mapped from EFileAttachInfo.ArrayInput[1])

formName.description: Form name if applicable, null if not available (mapped from EFileAttachInfo.ArrayFormInfoInput[0])

formElement.description: Form element name if applicable, extracted from pipe-delimited string, null if not available (mapped from EFileAttachInfo.ArrayFormInfoInput[1].Split('|').First())
